description: Domus is a home hub that remembers what you forget. Ask about your home and let ChatGPT act on it: look up what filter your furnace takes, check which appliance warranties are about to lapse, log a repair you just did, add a new appliance with its model, serial, and warranty, or open a document like an inspection report and review it. Domus keeps a living record of every property you own — appliances, documents, maintenance schedules, and air filters — synced across web, iOS, and Android. This plugin can both read and update your Domus home. Free to start; your data stays exportable and deletable, and you can revoke access anytime.

defaultPrompt: What size filter does my furnace take, and is it due for a change?
Which of my appliance warranties expire in the next 90 days?
Log that I replaced my water heater today.
